theValidationRequestTimedOutPleaseCheckY: Chikumbiro chekusimbisa chapera. Tapota tarisa kubatanidza netiweki yako woedza zvakare.

downloadProgressEmpty: Kufambira mberi kwako kwekurodha kuchaonekwa pano
importModelReadme: Ongorora zvinyorwa zvemuenzaniso zverezinesi rayo, mitauro inotsigirwa, ndangariro inodiwa uye chinangwa chekushandisa usati wadhawunirodha.
settingsLanguageHelp: Shanduko dzemutauro dzinoshanda kune iyo interface. Mhinduro dzemuenzaniso dzinoenderana nemirairo yako nemitauro inotsigirwa nemhando yakasarudzwa.
apiFallbackHint: Kiyi yekutanga ndeye #1. Novera anoedzazve kiyi inotevera mushure memhinduro 401, 403 kana 429.
unexpectedErrorHelp: Pane chakaipa. Gadzirisa peji rino kana kubata rutsigiro kana dambudziko rikaramba riripo.
dependencySomeCoreBackendFilesAreMissing: Mamwe mafaira ekumashure haapo kana kushatiswa - izvi zvinowanzoreva kuti kudhawunirodha kwakavhiringidzwa kana kuti dura rakatorwa zvishoma. Dzima backend woidhawunirodha kubva Novera marongero.
dependencyInstallNcclFromTheNvidiaDevelo: Isa NCCL kubva kuNVIDIA Saiti yeMugadziri. NCCL inoshandiswa pakutaura kwakawanda--GPU.
dependencyInstallNcclViaTheNvidiaPackage: Isa NCCL uchishandisa NVIDIA pasuru repository. PaDebian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install libnccl2 libnccl-dev. Ona iyo NVIDIA NCCL gidhidhi yekuisa ye distro yako.
dependencyInstallCudnnFromTheNvidiaDevel: Isa cuDNN kubva kuNVIDIA Saiti yeMugadziri woisa maDLL padivi peapp kana muSystem32.
dependencyInstallCudnnViaTheNvidiaPackag: Isa cuDNN kuburikidza neNVIDIA pasuru repository kana kudhawunirodha tarball wokopa libs ku/usr/local/cuda/lib64.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanRuntimeFromLun: Isa iyo Vulkan Runtime kubva LunarG. Mutyairi wako weGPU anogona kunge atoisanganisira — gadzirisa mutyairi wako GPU kutanga.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanLoaderOnUbuntu: Isa Vulkan loader: paUbuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libvulkan1. Pa Arch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-loader. PaRHEL/Fedora: sudo dnf install vulkan-loader.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkitFromNvidi: Isa CUDA Toolkit kubva NVIDIA. Panguva yekuisa, sarudza "CUDA" zvikamu.
Isa CUDA Toolkit kubva NVIDIA. PaDebian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. Pa RHEL/Fedora: shandisa NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit11FromNvi: Isa CUDA Toolkit 11 kubva NVIDIA. Panguva yekuisa, sarudza "CUDA" zvikamu.
Isa CUDA Toolkit 11 kubva NVIDIA. PaDebian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-11. Pa RHEL/Fedora: shandisa NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit12FromNvi: Isa CUDA Toolkit 12 kubva NVIDIA. Panguva yekuisa, sarudza "CUDA" zvikamu.
Isa CUDA Toolkit 12 kubva NVIDIA. PaDebian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. Pa RHEL/Fedora: shandisa NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit13FromNvi: Isa CUDA Toolkit 13 kubva NVIDIA. Panguva yekuisa, sarudza "CUDA" zvikamu.
Isa CUDA Toolkit 13 kubva NVIDIA. PaDebian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-13. Pa RHEL/Fedora: shandisa NVIDIA repo.
generationCountHint: Sarudza kuti mangani mifananidzo, mateki emimhanzi kana mavhidhiyo ekugadzira (1–10). Chinhu chimwe nechimwe chinogadzirwa mukutevedzana. Mira inodzima mabasa asara.
